verdict.rationale: Aider's docs say it works with LLM provider APIs and OpenAI-compatible endpoints rather than an Aider account, which implies API-key-based access, but no evidence item explicitly documents supplying an API key. Config via AIDER_xxx environment variables and switching models with --model are documented, yet key handling itself is not shown. missing for 10: explicit documentation of API key flags or environment variables per provider, confirmation that no Aider account login is required, independent hands-on corroboration of key-based setup

support.subject: As a developer, I can authenticate with an API key instead of an account login

citations.quote: Aider works best with LLM APIs
It can also access local models that provide an Open AI compatible API.
Or by setting environment variables like `AIDER_xxx`
